case_note: Simulated benchmark case: Wang et al. 2025 repo data/dataSim/Patient1/P1_SEEG_SEEG_fit.npz (SEEG-stimulation-induced seizure, 163 bipolar SEEG channels, 162-region VEP atlas SC + gain) attached to A0067-DatasetCard. Not patient recordings; no outcomes involved.

hypotheses.label: Documented ground truth: single-node EZ = Left-O2 (VEP region index 66, 0-based)
hypotheses.basis: Paper (PMC12457187) Fig. 3: P1 SEEG-stim simulation 'seizures were located around the left O2'; Fig. 5 legend: 'we obtained the ground-truth left O2'. Stimulated contact GL'5-6, 50 Hz, 3.5 s, 1 ms pulses.
hypotheses.status: primary (documented truth, but exact simulation x0 values NOT documented for P1)

hypotheses.label: Extended occipital EZN: Left-O2 + Left-Occipital-pole + Left-Lingual-gyrus
hypotheses.basis: Authors' own HMC result on this scenario: repo data/Patient1_SEEG_stimulation.xlsx (Fig. 3d source data, 2000 EV draws x 10 regions): EV median O2 1.00, Occipital-pole 0.67, Lingual-gyrus 0.61, STS-posterior 0.51, Calcarine 0.49; text: 'two neighboring regions (left lingual gyrus and left occipital pole) were the second group'. In the neural-field simulation the EZ patch can spread to neighbouring regions through local connectivity.
hypotheses.status: alternative (author-reported inference result, not simulation truth)

hypotheses.label: Occipito-temporal network: Left-O2 + Left-O1 / Left-STS-posterior / Left-T2-posterior
hypotheses.basis: Secondary candidates reported by the authors for the P1 TI and multimodal scenarios (Fig. 4d left O1; Fig. 5b left STS posterior; Patient1_TI_stimulation.xlsx); these regions also carry large P1 SEEG gain.

hypotheses.label: Inversion follows sensor coverage rather than dynamics: top x0 in highest-gain regions (Left-Angular-gyrus, Left-Supramarginal-posterior, Left-Superior-parietal-lobule-P1, Left-Intraparietal-sulcus)
hypotheses.basis: Regions with the largest SEEG gain column sums in P1_SEEG_SEEG_fit.npz (computed from the file). A failure-mode hypothesis, not a clinical one.

hypotheses.label: No region reliably above the excitability threshold / posterior near prior (data features uninformative after the pipeline's feature extraction)
hypotheses.basis: Model mismatch: data generated by a 20,484-vertex neural-field Epileptor-Stimulation model (extra slow variable m, stimulation input); inverted with a region-level 2D Epileptor without stimulation. Feature extraction adds noise and uses sfreq=250 although time_steps imply 100 Hz.

source_evidence.use: feature extraction and inference settings (hpf=10, lpf=1, sfreq=250, n_samples=150, crop 100:700, N(0,0.2) unseeded noise, 50 L-BFGS -> best 8 -> 16 NUTS chains, warmup 500/samples 500, delta 0.99, max_depth 7). Configured for P1_TI_SEEG_fit; we substitute P1_SEEG_SEEG_fit. Plotted outputs embedded in that notebook come from a different dataset (sub-01 vep_open), not P1.

simulation settings; ALL configured pid='Patient2', EZ='Left-F1-lateral-prefrontal' (dk: ctx-lh-superiorfrontal), EZ vertices x0=-2.2, threshold 1.8; others x0=-3.5, threshold 100; stimulation PM'3-4 50 Hz 3 mA. P1 configuration not in repo.

TI simulation: background x0=-2.5, threshold 10; EZ list ['Left-F1-lateral-prefrontal'] x0=-2.3 threshold 1.8; PZ loop sets x0=-2.1 threshold 4.5 but PZ list is empty as committed. P1 configuration not in repo.

source_evidence.source: data/Patient1_SEEG_stimulation.xlsx, Patient1_TI_stimulation.xlsx @5367ef4 (downloaded for this task, 104 kB each, Apache-2.0 repo)
source_evidence.use: authors' posterior EV draws (2000 x 10 regions) for P1 synthetic scenarios = qualitative reference for recovery

source_evidence.source: Wang et al. 2025 Nat Comput Sci, PMC12457187 full text (Europe PMC)
source_evidence.use: P1 synthetic ground truth 'left O2'; EV definition (onset of x>0, EV=-log(((t_i-t0)+1)/20), no seizure -> t_i=200, normalised to [0,1] per sample); 16 chains from 8 MAP inits

priors.x0: x0 = -3.0 + 0.30 * V * x0_star, x0_star ~ N(0,1), V = right singular vectors of the SEEG gain (orthonormal) => marginal x0_i ~ N(-3.0, 0.30^2), exchangeable across regions (no region-specific prior; hypotheses H1-H4 are NOT encoded in the prior)
priors.fixed: x_init=-1.98, dt=0.1, tau0=15, I1=3.1; first 10 time points excluded from likelihood
priors.hypothesis_prior_weights: equal / not specified (no hypothesis-level prior); hypotheses are evaluated post hoc from the region-level posterior

unobserved_node_assumptions: All 162 VEP regions are modelled; SEEG (163 bipolar channels) samples only part of the brain. Regions with small gain columns are weakly identified and their x0 posterior should stay near the prior N(-3,0.3).
Subcortical/cerebellar regions present in SC/gain are treated identically to cortex.
Stimulation input and the slow accumulation variable m of the generating model are NOT represented in the inversion model (deliberate structural mismatch of the published pipeline).
Ground-truth x0 per region for the P1 files is not stored and not documented; truth for recovery scoring is the documented EZ label (Left-O2) only.
discrimination_checks: Rank of Left-O2 by posterior mean x0 and by posterior median EV among 162 regions (H1 supported if rank 1).
P(x0 > -2.05) per region (bifurcation reference line used in the repo's posterior plots) and the set of regions exceeding it vs truth {Left-O2}.
Posterior x0/EV of Left-Occipital-pole, Left-Lingual-gyrus vs Left-O1, Left-STS-posterior, Left-T2-posterior (H2 vs H3).
Spearman correlation between posterior mean x0 and gain column sum, and whether top regions are the highest-gain regions (H4).
Posterior-vs-prior contraction for x0 (H0): sd ratio and shift of posterior relative to N(-3,0.3).
Posterior predictive check of the log-envelope features (residual RMSE, channel-wise correlation), plus agreement of EV ranking with the authors' xlsx posteriors.
